```{r build-table, include=FALSE}
# Compute prevalence 95% CIs (exact binomial)
n_patients <- nrow(data_complete)

prev_ci <- function(p, n) {
  ci <- binom.test(round(p * n), n)$conf.int
  sprintf("%.2f\u2013%.2f", ci[1], ci[2])
}

# Build the table data frame
table_1 <- data.frame(
  Category = c(
    rep("Biomarker prevalences", 2),
    rep("Health-state utilities", 2),
    rep("Treatment costs (\u20AC)", 4),
    rep("Other costs (\u20AC)", 2),
    rep("Structural parameters", 2)
  ),
  Parameter = c(
    "CRP-positive",
    "TMB/BRAF-positive",
    "Progression-free",
    "Post-progression",
    "Nivolumab per cycle",
    "FLOX per cycle",
    "CRP testing",
    "NGS testing",
    "Monitoring per cycle",
    "End-of-life",
    "Discount rate",
    "Time horizon"
  ),
  Base_case = c(
    sprintf("%.3f", l_params_base$p_crp),
    sprintf("%.3f", l_params_base$p_tmb_braf),
    sprintf("%.2f", l_params_base$u_np),
    sprintf("%.2f", l_params_base$u_p),
    sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(l_params_base$c_drug_nivo), big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(l_params_base$c_drug_FLOX), big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(l_params_base$c_test_CRP), big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(l_params_base$c_test_NGS), big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(l_params_base$c_test_CT), big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("\u20AC%s", format(round(l_params_base$c_other_last), big.mark = ",")),
    "4%",
    "10 years"
  ),
  Range = c(
    prev_ci(l_params_base$p_crp, n_patients),
    prev_ci(l_params_base$p_tmb_braf, n_patients),
    sprintf("%.2f\u2013%.2f",
            l_params_base$u_np * (1 - DSA_mult),
            min(l_params_base$u_np * (1 + DSA_mult), 1.0)),
    sprintf("%.2f\u2013%.2f",
            l_params_base$u_p * (1 - DSA_mult),
            min(l_params_base$u_p * (1 + DSA_mult), 1.0)),
    sprintf("%s\u2013%s",
            format(round(l_params_base$c_drug_nivo * (1 - DSA_mult)), big.mark = ","),
            format(round(l_params_base$c_drug_nivo * (1 + DSA_mult)), big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("%s\u2013%s",
            format(round(l_params_base$c_drug_FLOX * (1 - DSA_mult)), big.mark = ","),
            format(round(l_params_base$c_drug_FLOX * (1 + DSA_mult)), big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("%s\u2013%s",
            format(round(l_params_base$c_test_CRP * (1 - DSA_mult)), big.mark = ","),
            format(round(l_params_base$c_test_CRP * (1 + DSA_mult)), big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("%s\u2013%s",
            format(round(l_params_base$c_test_NGS * (1 - DSA_mult)), big.mark = ","),
            format(round(l_params_base$c_test_NGS * (1 + DSA_mult)), big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("%s\u2013%s",
            format(round(l_params_base$c_test_CT * (1 - DSA_mult)), big.mark = ","),
            format(round(l_params_base$c_test_CT * (1 + DSA_mult)), big.mark = ",")),
    sprintf("%s\u2013%s",
            format(round(l_params_base$c_other_last * (1 - DSA_mult)), big.mark = ","),
            format(round(l_params_base$c_other_last * (1 + DSA_mult)), big.mark = ",")),
    "0\u20138%",
    "5\u201320 yr"
  ),
  Distribution = c(
    "Beta", "Beta",
    "Beta", "Beta",
    "Gamma", "Gamma", "Gamma", "Gamma",
    "Gamma", "Gamma",
    "Fixed", "Fixed"
  ),
  Source = c(
    "METIMMOX", "METIMMOX",
    "METIMMOX EQ-5D", "METIMMOX EQ-5D",
    "NoMA", "NoMA", "Local", "Local",
    "Ref 27", "Ref 28",
    "NoMA guidelines", ""
  ),
  Notes = c(
    sprintf("95%% CI: %.1f\u2013%.1f%%",
            binom.test(round(l_params_base$p_crp * n_patients), n_patients)$conf.int[1] * 100,
            binom.test(round(l_params_base$p_crp * n_patients), n_patients)$conf.int[2] * 100),
    sprintf("95%% CI: %.1f\u2013%.1f%%",
            binom.test(round(l_params_base$p_tmb_braf * n_patients), n_patients)$conf.int[1] * 100,
            binom.test(round(l_params_base$p_tmb_braf * n_patients), n_patients)$conf.int[2] * 100),
    "Danish tariff",
    "Danish tariff",
    "40% discount",
    "",
    "CRP only",
    "TMB/BRAF only",
    "CT scans",
    "",
    "",
    ""
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r display-table}
kable(table_1 %>% select(-Category),
      caption = "Table 1: Model input parameters",
      format = "html",
      col.names = c("Parameter", "Base case", "Range", "Distribution", "Source", "Notes"),
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "l", "l", "l")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE,
                font_size = 11) %>%
  pack_rows(index = table(table_1$Category)[unique(table_1$Category)]) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "NoMA = Norwegian Medicines Agency. NGS = next-generation sequencing.",
      "Costs in 2023 euros. Ranges for costs and utilities represent +/-20% variation for DSA.",
      "Prevalence ranges based on 95% exact binomial confidence intervals."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) {
  dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

write.csv(table_1 %>% select(-Category), file = here("tables", "table_1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Table saved to:", here("tables", "table_1.csv"), "\n")
```

Table 1 has been saved to `tables/table_1.csv`.
